description: Referral management + Partner Performance + Active Partners. Builds the Referrals module (with linkage to Sales Leads and Bookings), the Active Partners list, and the Partner Performance page with health categories and partner scoring. This realises the referral->sales-lead->booking->revenue chain from spec sections 12/13 and surfaces the partner_score/health from FEAT-002's b2b-scoring. Depends on FEAT-002 and FEAT-003.
steps: Referrals route src/routes/_authenticated/b2b/referrals.tsx (spec section 12). List with fields: Referral ID, CA Firm, Referring Contact, Referred Client Name, Client Phone, Date Received, Assigned Salesperson, Service Required, Referral Status, Converted?, Booking ID, Booking Value, Revenue, Referral Date, Converted Date, Notes. REFERRAL_STATUSES from src/lib/b2b.ts. 'New Referral' dialog selecting the CA Firm + referring contact. Make clear a partner != a referral (one firm -> many referrals).

Referral -> Sales Lead linkage: add an action to convert/push a referral into the existing Sales Leads system — insert a public.leads row (reuse the lead-to-booking / lead-shape conventions; set source appropriately, carry client name/phone/service) and store the resulting lead_id back on the referral. When that Sales lead later becomes a booking, allow linking the referral.booking_id to the public.bookings row and capture booking_value/revenue (read from the booking's amount_after_tds/total_amount per existing conventions). Set converted=true and converted_date on conversion. Guard against breaking existing leads/bookings behaviour — this is additive linking only.

Active Partners route src/routes/_authenticated/b2b/partners.tsx — CA firms whose partner_status indicates an onboarded/active partner (filter on health category). Columns reuse the firm performance totals.

Partner Performance route src/routes/_authenticated/b2b/partner-performance.tsx (spec section 13): per CA firm show Partner Status, Total Referrals, Converted Referrals, Bookings, Revenue, Last Referral, Last Booking, Last Contact, Assigned B2B Employee, and the computed Partner Score + health category (Strategic Partner / Active Partner / Potential / Dormant / Lost) from src/lib/b2b-scoring.ts. Sortable/filterable table. Recompute scores from live referral/booking/activity data via b2b-queries aggregation.
Add Referrals, Active Partners, Partner Performance to the Partnerships nav subgroup. guardRoles(['admin','b2b']).
logAudit on referral create/status-change/conversion. Rebuild to regenerate routeTree.gen.ts and commit. Prettier new files.
acceptance_criteria: Referrals module lists all referral fields, supports create, and visibly links a referral to a Sales Lead and to a Booking (lead_id/booking_id populated; converted flag + dates set).
Converting a referral inserts a public.leads row additively without altering existing Sales lead flows, and the referral stores the lead_id.
Active Partners and Partner Performance pages show per-firm totals (referrals, converted, bookings, revenue, last activity) and the computed partner score + health category, sortable/filterable.
Partner scoring/health is driven by the tested src/lib/b2b-scoring.ts.
`npx tsc --noEmit` clean, `bun run test` green, `bun run build` succeeds.
verification: Confirm referral->lead->booking linkage columns populate and existing Sales leads/bookings queries are untouched.
